claims.claim: The Venetian Resort Las Vegas lists canned non-alcoholic beverages such as Coke at eleven dollars each on its 2026 in-room minibar menu.
claims.episode_span: A can of Coke sits behind the glass door of a hotel minibar priced at eleven dollars.
claims.source_title: Refreshment Center Menu | The Venetian Resort Las Vegas
claims.supporting_quote: Coke, Diet Coke, and Sprite at $11 each

claims.claim: Hotel minibar items are typically priced 300–400% above retail prices.
claims.episode_span: Against an eleven-dollar minibar price the ratio already exceeds fifty.
claims.source_title: Hotel Mini Bar: Facts, Pricing, and How It Works

claims.claim: Pierre Agrario of Bartech System International stated that automated minibars increase revenue capture by 30% to 40% compared with an honor system.
claims.episode_span: Automated sensor systems reduce some of those visits by reporting only rooms that show activity.
claims.source_title: Fridge benefits: Automated minibars reshape hotel guest experience and profitability
claims.supporting_quote: What we’ve seen is that—compared to an honor system—the capture of revenue increases by about 30% to 40%
